title: Becoming an AI Engineer: AI Engineering Foundations
description: The hub and first lab of an AI Engineering curriculum: LLM API calls, structured outputs, tool calling, a hand-written agent loop and an eval gate with negative controls, built on a fictional PDLC assistant and runnable offline with a fake model provider.
